category: German multihoster with usenet, torrent and TV recorder

free_tier.stated: Free, permanently, at 0 EUR: five filehosters, usenet with 5 connections, forum support and XMPP access - but 'nur mit Free MB-Guthaben', i.e. only against a balance of Free MB that the user acquires separately.
free_tier.notes: The asterisk names the hosts: 'drop.download, FileFactory, FILESTORE.to, MEGA, Uptobox, katfile.com und YouTube' - seven names for a '5 Filehoster' headline, because YouTube is not a filehoster.

per_object_cap.stated: not stated on the free tariff; no single-file ceiling is published

retention.stated: not applicable: no storage on the free tariff; downloaded traffic is deducted from the Free MB balance

egress.terms: 'Sind Sie Free-User, wird jede Datei die Sie herunterladen im Voraus bezahlt. Das bedeutet, dass Ihr tatsächlich verbrauchter Traffic ignoriert wird. Außerdem gilt für Sie kein Traffic-Rabatt' - a free user pays each file in advance from the balance and gets none of the 33% or 50% host discounts.
egress.free_allowance: only what the Free MB balance holds

interface_detail: A JSON API at high-way.me/api/ (an /api/hoster endpoint returns the live host list with per-host discount factors), plus WebDAV and FTP for content the user owns.
tooling: Documented API through a public Postman collection, JDownloader and pyLoad integrations, WebDAV/FTP/SFTP access, a Windows tool and an Android TV app.
chaining: A free balance is useful only for a handful of named hosts, and the balance itself comes from community activity rather than from an allowance; it is a way to test the service, not a way to move a terabyte.

limits.value: free downloads are paid in advance from the Free MB balance, with no host discount
usenet with 5 connections, and only active from a 5,000 Free MB balance
registration is vetted: 'Unsere Plattform steht nur überprüften Nutzern zur Verfügung ... Die Prüfung einer Registrierung beträgt wenige Stunden'

limits_note: Forum registration is a prerequisite for every other service: 'Die Anmeldung bei unserer Diskussionsplattform (dem Forum) ist Grundvoraussetzung zur Nutzung aller anderen von uns angebotenen Dienstleistungen'.
binding_note: There is no free traffic allowance at all - the tier runs on a prepaid balance - so the byte counter is the constraint before any host or concurrency rule.

identity_cost.detail: E-mail registration followed by manual review, which the vendor says takes a few hours and exists because 'gut hundert Forenspammer pro Tag' try to register. A forum account is required for every service.

reliability_note: A vetting queue stands between a new user and the service; free downloads get no host discount and no refund of unused traffic; the vendor opens registrations only in windows.
confidence_note: Free-tier composition, host names, usenet connection count and the vetting rule all come from the vendor's tariff page read. The size of a Free MB is defined in the terms as 1,000 KB, so the balance is a decimal byte count.

evidence.proved: 'Free, ab € 0 dauerhaft', 'nur 5 Filehoster', 'Usenet mit 5 Verbindungen', 'nur mit Free MB-Guthaben', and the host names in the footnote
free users pay each file in advance and receive no traffic discount; premium users are charged only for what they used
forum registration is a prerequisite for all services, and HIGHWAY sells decimal kilobytes (1,000 bytes to the KB)
'Unsere Plattform steht nur überprüften Nutzern zur Verfügung', registrations open, review takes a few hours

price_per_tb_month: EUR 0 with no included traffic; consumption is charged to a prepaid Free MB balance
notes: It is kept as its own record because its honest ceiling is zero bytes rather than a small number.

extras.torrent: no on the free tariff; the torrent downloader is a Premium feature
